source: Saved before/after CALIBRATION prediction vectors and the same archived mature labels, never new fits or SEALED
weights: Equal weight per canonical instrument/date/event/horizon, exact duplicates once, conflicts rejected
maturity: Source CALIBRATION last date and consumer knowledge cutoff; archived label/maturity/availability required
log_loss: Explicit two columns [P0,P1], labels[0,1]. Align model per-class probability floor1e-15; separately show library default machine epsilon
bins: 5 uniform bins; preserve Roll left-closed convention incl1 in final bin; show library raw uniform right-edge convention separately; per-Roll-bin calibration_curve n_bins1 for aligned means/frequencies
independence: None; CAL fit reused, no CV/calibrator fit or statistical qualification
